d:
This is the most personal I have ever been with my stand up comedy! An excerpt from my latest stand up comedy special "Professor of Tomfoolery", I talk about how generationally, Indian families fight at home!
Through my own story of being in a marriage, we millennials are taking the first steps at improving the ever taboo subject of conflict!
I did my best to showcase that personally journey through this comedy performance with the aim of making people feel less alone so we all know we are in this together!
